{{pkmn|Masters EX}} |leader=yes |gym=Humilau Gym |specialist=yes |type={{t|Water}} types |badge=Badge#Wave Badge{{!}}Wave Badge |anime=yes |epnum=BW094 |gameanim=yes |envagame=[[Ray Chase]][https://twitter.com/RayChase/status/1167542072540352519 Ray Chase on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |javagame=[[Ryota Iwasaki]]Nintendo DREAM (vol. 329) ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |epname=The Road to Humilau! |enva=[[Ted Lewis|Ed Paul]] |java=[[Yūji Ueda]] |pv=yes |pvnum=GOTCHA! |pvname=GOTCHA! }} '''Marlon''' (Japanese: '''シズイ''' ''Shizui'') is the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Humilau City]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as the [[Humilau Gym]]. He [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Water}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. He gives the {{badge|Wave}} to Trainers who defeat him. ==In the core series games== Marlon appears in {{B2W2}} as the eighth and final Gym Leader that the {{player}} challenges. He is a big-hearted [[Pokémon Trainer]] who gives passionate advice. Marlon also seems to be a very relaxed and carefree man, as shown by his obliviousness as to who [[Team Plasma]] are and what they do, even asking if Team Plasma are [[Villainous team|bad people]]. Marlon specializes in Water-type Pokémon. Upon defeating him, he will reward the player with a Wave Badge and {{TM|55|Scald}}. Outside of battle, Marlon is a fisherman who catches {{type|Water}} Pokémon which he would later use in future Gym battles. Upon arriving in [[Humilau City]], Marlon is absent from the Gym, and the player is sent to find him. The player meets Marlon just as they head north of the Gym, in which he returns to it and awaits a Gym battle. After the Gym battle, Marlon jumps into the ocean and swims away. Upon exiting the Gym, [[Hugh]] walks up and congratulates the player on gaining all eight of Unova's Gym Badges, and then their attention turns to Team Plasma, during which Marlon walks up and asks about them. He then heads off to the [[Seaside Cave]] to find the [[Plasma Frigate]]. Later on, at {{rt|21|Unova}}, he is seen jumping off the Plasma Frigate after lowering the boarding plank, and then heads back to the Gym, leaving the player and Hugh to deal with Team Plasma. During the post-game, Marlon joins the other Gym Leaders in participating in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]]. ===Pokémon=== ===={{B2W2}}==== =====Gym battle===== ======Easy Mode/Normal Mode====== {{color2|000|Pokémon Black and White Versions 2|Black 2 and White 2}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Marlon/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Marlon anime.png|thumb|250px|Marlon in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'']] ====''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''==== Marlon appeared in ''[[BW094|The Road to Humilau!]]'', where {{un|Cameron}} aimed to challenge his [[Gym]] for his final [[Badge]]. After Cameron and {{Ash}} lost their way to [[Humilau City]], Marlon found the two {{pkmn|Trainer}}s and took them to his Gym. There, he faced Cameron in a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}. Although Marlon had a powerful [[Party|team]], he was defeated by Cameron's {{p|Samurott}}, giving Cameron his last Gym Badge. ====[[Pokémon movie]]s==== Marlon made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. ====Character==== Marlon is a spirited [[Gym Leader]] with a laidback personality. He has a strong team of {{t|Water}} Pokémon, which perform well in the [[Humilau Gym]]'s open ocean battlefield. Marlon utilizes offense to bring down his challengers and takes advantage of the Gym's aquatic setting. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Marlon's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marlon |width=68 |pkmn=Wailord |type1=Water |img=Marlon Wailord.png |epnum=BW094 |epname=The Road to Humilau! |desc={{p|Wailord}} was used to transport Marlon, {{Ash}}, and {{un|Cameron}} to the [[Humilau Gym]]. None of Wailord's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marlon |pkmn=Jellicent |gender=male |type1=Water |type2=Ghost |img=Marlon Jellicent.png |epnum=BW094 |epname=The Road to Humilau! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Billy Bob Thompson |desc={{p|Jellicent}} was the first Pokémon that Marlon used against {{un|Cameron}} in their [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}. He battled Cameron's {{p|Ferrothorn}}, and while he was defeated by Ferrothorn's {{m|Thunderbolt}}, his [[Ability]] was activated, thereby disabling the [[move]]. Jellicent's only known move is {{m|Shadow Ball}} and his Ability is {{a|Cursed Body}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marlon |pkmn=Mantine |type1=Water |type2=Flying |img=Marlon Mantine.png |epnum=BW094 |epname=The Road to Humilau! |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Unshō Ishizuka |desc={{p|Mantine}} is Marlon's ace Pokémon. It was the second Pokémon that Marlon used against {{un|Cameron}} in their Gym battle. It quickly knocked out {{p|Ferrothorn}} with a combination of Wing Attack, Bullet Seed, and Psybeam. Afterwards, Mantine faced off against Cameron's female {{p|Samurott}} and was knocked out without landing a single attack on her. Mantine's known moves are {{m|Wing Attack}}, {{m|Bullet Seed}}, and {{m|Psybeam}}.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{water color light}}|bordercolor={{water color}} |ja=うえだゆうじ ''[[Yūji Ueda]]'' |da=Niclas Mortensen |en=[[Ted Lewis|Ed Paul]] |cs=Petr Gelnar |es_la=Víctor Ugarte |es_eu=Pablo Sevilla |pl=Przemysław Stippa |pt_br=Robson Kumode |sv=Jesper Adefelt }} ===GOTCHA!=== Marlon briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Roxie Marlon Adventures.png|220px|thumb|Marlon in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Black & White}}===== Marlon debuted in ''[[PS512|Hallway Hijinks]]'', where he participated as a competitor in the {{un|Pokémon League}}. After battling his way through Victory Road, he eventually made it into the top 8. In ''[[PS514|The Tournament Continues]]'', Marlon faced [[Colress|Hood Man]] in the quarterfinals. Despite managing to disable the moves of Hood Man's {{p|Beheeyem}}, Marlon ended up losing, allowing Hood Man to advance to the next round. In ''[[PS517|Something Suspicious]]'', Marlon attempted to head back home, only to be approached by {{adv|White}}. When asked on what he knew about Hood Man, Marlon revealed his opponent had managed to somehow enter the League without collecting a single Gym [[Badge]]. White decided to expose Hood Man for cheating, but was stopped by Marlon, who was perfectly fine with losing since his opponent was a strong {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Marlon stated that he found {{adv|Cheren}} more suspicious and suggested that White begin investigating him next. ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== Sometime before the events of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}, Marlon became the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Humilau City]]. In ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'', Marlon and [[Benga]] helped rescue Cheren's class and [[Roxie]] from [[Castelia City]], which had been frozen by the [[Plasma Frigate]]. After explaining the situation, Marlon and Began asked Cheren and Roxie to join them and launch a counterattack against [[Team Plasma]]. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Jellicent 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marlon |pkmn=Jellicent |stage1=Frillish |gender=male |type1=Water |type2=Ghost |img=Marlon Frillish Adventures.png |img_size=120px |cap=Marlon's Frillish |img2=Marlon Jellicent Adventures.png |img2_size=170px |epnum=PS514 |epname=The Tournament Continues |desc={{p|Jellicent}} is Marlon's only known Pokémon. He has been with Marlon ever since he was a {{p|Frillish}}. Marlon used him to battle Hood Man's {{p|Beheeyem}} at the Unova Pokémon League. Although he put up a good fight, Beheeyem defeated him with {{m|Shadow Ball}}, giving Hood Man the victory. Later, he was healed by White's {{p|Alomomola}}, Nancy, in an attempt to get Marlon's trust. Jellicent's known moves are {{m|Scald}} and {{m|Recover}}, and his Ability is {{a|Cursed Body}}.}} Marlon has at least two other Pokémon, as he participated in the quarterfinals of the Unova Pokémon League, which requires a Single Battle involving three Pokémon. ====Badges obtained==== =====Unova League===== * At least eight unknown Badges ====Achievements==== =====Pokémon League===== Marlon has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * {{un|Pokemon League}} - Top 8 (''[[PS514|The Tournament Continues]]'') ==Trivia== * Marlon's Japanese Leader title is {{tt|海よりも　海な　男！|The man who is more marine than the sea!}}. * Marlon speaks in a {{wp|Kyushu}} dialect in the Japanese version. * Marlon is the first [[Gym Leader]] to appear in only one {{pkmn|animated series}} episode since [[Bugsy]], who appeared in ''[[EP144|Gettin' The Bugs Out]]'', 607 episodes prior to Marlon's appearance. ** However, at the time of Marlon's animated series appearance, [[Chuck]] had also only appeared in one episode, before making a second appearance in ''[[JN039|Octo-Gridlock at the Gym!]]''. * According to one of the [[television]] stations in [[Unova]], Marlon learned to jump by practicing with the {{p|Mantine}} that lived by his childhood home. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{water color}}; border:3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- !
